canonical_statement: The physical world and its foundations are subject to catastrophic dissolution by divine agency.

attributions.surface_quote: I have effected the overthrow of all that exist.

canonical_statement: Human existence and the natural order are contingent upon the commands and interventions of deities.

attributions.surface_quote: Thou didst command me, and they are created.

canonical_statement: Ritual and memorial practice serve as the mechanism for maintaining relationship with the divine.

attributions.surface_quote: A memorial of drinking and holy memorial sacrifices.

canonical_statement: The divine voice possesses the ontological capacity to manifest or create reality.

attributions.surface_quote: The voice creates.

canonical_statement: The divine principle is manifested as a plurality of localized entities sharing a common identity.

attributions.chapter: INSCRIPTION OF THE VANNIC KING MENUAS
attributions.surface_quote: there were many Khaldis-gods who are invoked by the Vannic kings
